description: The gate screen (the 'You're invited' name-entry screen) gets the FULL-COLOR invitation pattern as its background so it pops — the Team Lead explicitly wants full color here, distinct from the accepted 35%-over-cream wall used elsewhere. The name-entry form sits on a solid cream panel echoing the invitation's arch-window composition; the page is text-light, so full color behind a panel conforms to the no-text-over-pattern rule.
title: Name gate page gets the full-color invitation pattern background
acceptance_criteria: The gate page renders the full-color invitation pattern background at all viewports
The name-entry form sits on a solid token-cream panel meeting WCAG contrast
No text sits over the pattern
